theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_planar_support_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → BoundaryVanishes T → Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → p ∈ Q → 0 < r → ball p r ⊆ U → T.support ∩ ball p r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) → HasMassDensity T p k → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball p r → T.massOn W = (k : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (W ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P)))
